label: Shopify orders export
notes: One row per line item: rows with the same Name are merged into one order; quantities are added, the first SKU is kept.
Shopify's Subtotal is after discounts, so gross = Subtotal + Discount Amount.
Shipping is what the customer paid, not what shipping cost the brand, so shipping_inr stays unknown until a courier file (Shiprocket) or a column is mapped.
Product cost, payment fee and return cost are not in the orders export: they stay unknown (null), never zero.
returned is read from Financial Status (refunded or partially_refunded): a refund is used as the sign of a return.
Email is hashed into customer_id; the address itself is not stored.
